name: ARC-500B New-Generation MMA Welder 400A

images.alt: GOWELLDE ARC-500B new generation MMA welding machine

summary: 400A at 80% duty in the proven 515×270 chassis — updated power stage, same footprint.
description: The ARC-500B refreshes the 500-class power stage with two G75N120 IGBTs, delivering 400A at 80% duty cycle in the same compact chassis as the ARC-400. A straightforward upgrade item for existing ARC-400 users who need more headroom for 5.0 mm rods.
